source:
@@U03425@@
That clever little number is one I'd like to snatch— but as soon as I grab, a lizard slithers from my hand, her braid slick as a snake! Ah! Then that one there, tall and slender! And what do I have but a bacchic wand with a pinecone at its tip! Where does this end? Aha, this fat one, then, for a bit of a revel, but this the last! Here goes! Ah, all squishy-squiggly! Orientals, I’ve heard, pay in gold for this! Oh, but the puffball bursts in two! Phew!
translation:
@@U03425@@
那个聪明的小数字是我想抢走的——但我一抓住，一只蜥蜴就从我手里滑了下来，她的辫子像蛇一样光滑！啊!然后就是那个，又高又瘦！我除了一根顶端有松果的酒鬼魔杖之外还有什么！这到哪里结束呢？啊哈，这个胖子，然后，为了一点狂欢，但这是最后一次！开始吧！啊，全都是软软的！我听说东方人为此支付黄金！哦，但是马勃裂成了两半！唷！
